high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene of a grand, illuminated building with architectural features reminiscent of traditional Indian or Mughal design. The structure is lit up with warm yellow lights, highlighting its intricate details and ornate facades. The building has multiple levels, with balconies and arches that are accentuated by the lighting. The central part of the building features a large, arched entranceway, which is also brightly lit, drawing attention to it as the focal point.
